_comment: Canonical golden vectors for the simhash64-v1 content fingerprint. SOURCE OF TRUTH for every implementation: coc (internal/fuzzy), infrastructure's Python verifier, word-certifier, gdoc-certifier, support-app-v2. Each repo's test suite MUST reproduce these digests byte-for-byte; a drift fails CI. The one exception is the 'empty' vector, whose note records a deliberate, specified divergence. See docs/verification-spec.md §6.3. Do not edit a digest in place — that is a breaking change requiring a new algorithm_id.

vectors.name: pangram
vectors.input: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.

vectors.name: reformat
vectors.input: the   QUICK brown fox	jumps over the lazy dog

vectors.name: empty
vectors.note: Implementation-defined (§6.3). Text with no shingles produces no features, so this digest is what the accumulator definition yields — but a conforming implementation MAY instead omit the fingerprint entirely, and HII's certifiers do. A verifier MUST treat a missing fingerprint as 'no claim', and MUST NOT treat an all-zero digest as evidence of a match.
